content: Orders usually leave the warehouse within two business days. Once an order has shipped, customers receive a tracking link by email. The tracking link opens the carrier's tracking page.
Customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery. Returned items must be unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are processed to the original payment method.
Live support is available Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, excluding public holidays.
